annotations.title: Quote a China to USA shipment

description: Prices a real shipment from China to a US address, 100 g to 2,000 kg, on Plain Freight's live pricing engine. Returns door to door prices in USD: each option covers freight, US customs clearance and delivery, and says whether US import duty is included (DDP) or paid at import. Carton dimensions affect the price: for light, bulky cargo the volumetric weight sets it. Side effects: each call records a separate quote request with Plain Freight, and if an email is given the written offer is emailed to that address once a second check settles (at most one offer email per address per day). Nothing is booked or charged. The result carries a quote_id, by which the second check's verdict can be read.

destination_zip.description: US destination ZIP code of the shipment

dimensions.description: Cartons and size, e.g. '4 cartons, 60x40x35 cm each'

email.description: Optional. Address the written offer is mailed to; replying to that email is one way to book.

name.description: Optional. The name to address the offer email to

notes.description: Optional shipment facts: HS code, Amazon FBA requirements, delivery constraints, certifications held

origin.description: Pickup city or supplier's city in China

product.description: What is being shipped, e.g. 'LED desk lamps, 500 units'

enum: Need best balance of cost and speed

name: generate_offer

book_url.description: plainfreight.com booking form, prefilled with this shipment and quote

needs_review.description: true: prices withheld until a person clears the goods

duties_included.description: true when US import duty is inside the price (DDP); false when duty is paid to the government at import

firm.description: false means an estimate confirmed before booking

price.description: Price in USD for the whole shipment

quote_id.description: Reference for the offer's second check and for booking

chargeable_kg.description: weight the price is computed on: the greater of actual and volumetric weight

title: Quote a China to USA shipment
